name: srm-ui
description: Frontend for SRM, the scheduler & resource management platform (Vue 3 + Vuetify + Pinia).

scripts.deploy: vite build && aws s3 sync dist s3://srm-website-554075145086-us-east-1-an --delete --exclude index.html --cache-control public,max-age=31536000,immutable --profile erp && aws s3 cp dist/index.html s3://srm-website-554075145086-us-east-1-an/index.html --cache-control no-cache --profile erp && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3KY4JEG04QNKG --paths '/*' --profile erp
